response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT g.SEX, g.cnt AS test_count, g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS fraction_of_total, g.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS above_average FROM g, s WHERE g.cnt > s.avg_cnt
